en: Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a broad town square with people walking and several horse-drawn carriages. On the left stands an ornate town hall with a stepped gable facade and an attached clock tower. Behind it rise two tall Gothic church towers and the large roof of a church. Surrounding the square are traditional multi‑story buildings with steep roofs. Decorative German text is printed at the top and along the left margin.
